asset_set: Questionnaire Q9 option 1 — Pitching startup ideas to investors

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under hands and flip-chart — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle paper-grain suggestion on flip-chart via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: confident founder-in-the-room energy — persuasive pitch moment, not a stiff boardroom
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: coral
accent.use: flip-chart border line, marker barrel, blazer cuff pinstripe

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: coral appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on marker barrel and lightbulb icon
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and flip-chart base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: gestures open-palm toward the flip-chart growth graphic
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: draws an upward trend arrow on the flip-chart with a marker
right_hand.grip: precision pinch between thumb and index finger

pose.gesture_summary: mid-pitch freeze frame — confident gesture meets marker stroke
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands presents a startup pitch, one hand gesturing open toward a small growth-chart flip-card while the other holds a marker mid-stroke on a simple upward arrow. A lightbulb icon glows softly on the corner of the flip-chart, capturing the confident, persuasive energy of a founder in the pitch room.

primary_objects.name: flip-chart card
primary_objects.detail: coral border line, simple upward bar-and-arrow growth graphic, no readable text

primary_objects.name: marker
primary_objects.detail: mid-stroke on the upward arrow, bullet tip visible

primary_objects.name: lightbulb icon sign
primary_objects.detail: simple flat bulb glyph with soft glow

subject.environment: minimal meeting-room table edge strip across bottom third, fades to transparent

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from coffee cup → flip-chart → marker hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: table edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: flip-chart silhouette + growth arrow readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter E, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, stiff boardroom gloom, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector education illustration, 640x640 square, transparent PNG background. KursoKo career quiz choice image for activity "Pitching startup ideas to investors". Style: friendly flat vector with consistent 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands only — match KursoKo RIASEC sticker art family but NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms with a rolled tailored blazer sleeve, left hand gesturing open-palm toward a paper flip-chart with a coral #FF8A65 border and a simple upward growth arrow, right hand drawing the arrow mid-stroke with a coral marker. A small yellow #FFD54F glowing lightbulb icon sits at the corner, coffee cup with coral sleeve nearby. Slim wristwatch on the left wrist. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C.
